claims.text: The authors compare MERF against existing application-specific techniques and tools for information extraction, including ANGE, ATEEMA, and GENTREE.
MERF is compared with SystemT, TEXTMARKER, and other rule-based techniques for entity and relation extraction.
The authors also mention annotation tools like MMAX2, BRAT, and Knowtator in their comparison.
